text.text: *Topic:* Should our team move to a four-day work week?

*Outcome (bridged consensus):*
>Pilot a four-day week with a Friday on-call rota to keep client coverage.

*What majority-rule would have picked:*
>Adopt a four-day week; productivity will hold.
*Information uptake (this scenario):* the minority shifted *+0.40* on average after the evidence; the majority *+0.02*. 2 of 5 participants moved.

elements.text: ⚠️ Uptake is a *scenario demonstration*, not data-validated. The bridging result IS validated on 6,605 real Habermas sessions (Phase A).
